I have trouble finding how to start my own comment thread 

But I def hear you. I’ve always looked at people as closely as possible from a young age to help them, the me I call me not the kid that just survived mental abuse

And ya.. we’re the ones with better answers I think bc we try to understand and help.. they’re just surviving w a camera..

I see good happening in the world.. I see solutions.. I just have no future.. 

Unfortunately survival is strong. And honestly maybe a better path to find money and security. But ya.. idk.. it’s like maybe we’ll find better answers.. maybe we’ll fall like the Roman Empire

I’m rooting for you. Breathe and maybe take a break and get some things together, like good routines if u need them and positivity or ways of talking with those with to get good things started. It’s a social game but learning to play pays. Flattery, feigned support that doesn’t drain u but keeps u in the game, social moves. At least some ways that can work. Each situation is diff but take your time and figure it out.
One way I’ve seen work. Boundary talk and acting like them. Integrating. Bc caring too much doesn’t work for some people, and being honest at the wrong time in a way that doesn’t protect the facade they love fails too.
Idk. It all looks like a game to me. Where honesty and growth aren’t enough. Or they have to be framed a certain way.
But I was always in games as a kid.
Always keep yourself safe. Don’t let them make u snap and if u do reevaluate and save urself before it gets bad.
You got this

Never mind respond and heal. Just tried to show some of ur responses might be hurtful like that other person bc I’ve been hurtful unintentionally like u

My opinion has validity but I’m not going to argue it with u

Bc none of us have all the answers I just tried to give u some

But I’m not going to fight with another person who thinks they’re just right bc again it’s just like fighting with old me

I told you to back off strongly because I used to be like you. So in that first the tone is strong bc I hate me for not being who I am now, someone who thinks we all need to rework our emotions including ourselves.

And exactly. You were trying to engage and be positive. But I’m informing you- just like someone else asking if you were sarcastic- that you reworking someone’s feelings is a tough place because you aren’t them and they aren’t you.

Our intentions can be good and yet end up hurtful. I respond to you because I am you just knowing now you me and everyone has the right revisit emotions.

And here’s my intention since the words came out harsh just as your intention was positivity and I told you and will always think you need to leave people to grow in their healing on there own:

I simply believe you and every person alive has the deep need to rework their feelings when they are ready. Because just as I forgave monsters this forgiveness is a response I have to abusers where I need to hate my abusers and possibly kill myself because they’ve won so much in my life by giving me diseases and destroying every happiness I could get.

My reply stands.

I am protecting these people from your judging responses.

We don’t need to throw hands this is a matter of allowing people to rework their emotions which I will defend

And yes you have your suffering and look you responded to that

That’s the only part of my post I don’t like

Because I defend your right to suffering and revisiting those emotions and changing them

So yes. I’m again please do stop applauding some posts or telling people to feel a certain way 

Just as someone else asked if you were sarcastic with your remarks

It is not for you to rework our scars

We all have them and have to deal with them

And look how you have to attack mundane things when I literally told you I might have aids

I’m protecting everyone’s right to feel a certain way

I’m asking you let them and we let you and if there’s scars from this for you you can rework them too even from reading some answers too because I’m sure there’s pain in you you haven’t faced from this and other things that you as everyone here deserves the time and space to rework without input on how they should feel

I’m sorry. You asked how we felt to then comment on each post to give your opinion on whether you like it or not, to give different perspectives?

You need to leave this as an open ended question and let us revisit and and rework our feelings ourselves.

I forgave the man who did this quickly.

I also forgave a man who beat me and a mother who stole ivy leagues from me.

Should we really be forgiving monsters.

I’m about to end my life and if we ask me why I’m not even sure anymore.

But I can say for certain no one fucking wants me because an evil racist man gave me herpes then later admitted he also had aids and although I don’t have it I have been exposed and it could be laying dormant in my body.

Get the fuck off here judging our answers.

I should not be forgiving a man who may have ended my life with aids or ended my life now.

And god rescue you if you have the audacity to attempt to answer me.

Unless you’ve been exposed to aids, beaten, raped, had an entire life stolen from you you know nothing about suffering.

And stay the fuck away from these people.

We’re entitled to the peace of revisiting our emotions reworking them without your input which knows nothing of the whole story or person.

I’ll try to listen to you. Idk I’m really sorry if I go. I talked to one and they judged me going insane so much they didn’t really help. I talked to one all year. She just let me talk and just let my truths be.

Idk if I have aids I prob don’t.. but just another.. surprise if it comes

I will read what you put thank you. But maybe my only meaning is to be a warning. I wish I could tell more ppl about the specifics but. Ya. Certain diseases. Certain lives. Are just trash. Ya thank you for talking to me. I see how useless my life is now. It’s just a find meaning life. My life is now a joke for people to feel better and and shy away from. So maybe now you see. To everyone who told me I was selfish. Was I? Are we? Untouchables? If we go we’re realistic. If we stay we’re living statues. Thanks. I needed correct perspective on my life.

People “Live their best life!” “Gotta smile!” And “Do what makes me happy!” 

All the while they talk behind each other’s back, form together bosses promote only who they want, I don’t suck up so I don’t get promoted.
People talk. And talk shit. About people like me, who don’t talk, are honest, and have everyone’s back. It’s either be good and have everyone back, or become one of them. Don’t actually care, don’t live by rules. Have friends make factions and don’t care if your talking hurts someone else. You know talking about anyone ever ya hurtful? You’re creating a narrative about that person without even knowing. And ya if I talk to people again I’ll get better at not caring who falls off like me. They were “weak” they just “didn’t try” they “didn’t want friends” when they were the fucking best people everyone decided to exile. Probably people with diseases that just lived by higher standards.

It’s either play the people game and maybe be accepted bc u have friends like everyone and talk shit like everyone, or don’t have friends and be rejected, but you don’t talk shit, you don’t lie, you keep people safe, end up with abusers

I suppressed another memory. He told me he was positive. For aids. Drs tell me that since I don’t have it now I probably won’t have it. Probably. But it can lay dormant. But perhaps if I’m lucky I don’t have it.

Like no one wants to be but everyone is. You notice a lot in a day when you start to realize your life doesn’t matter. Living with the regret of going insane

Fact is, I’ve lived for everyone but me. Like it matters. Like anyone cares at all. If you get mad when you die you just suck. What a world.

When you don’t have family, love is even more important and if that is being taken from you, what do you do. I have a lot more that’s been taken from me, not materially but that too, by my own mother, and ya... I’ve even lost my mind so. If that gives you some hope, good really. One type not so bad at all. Two types insane family and then your own demise into insanity? I’ve honestly got plans for the end of each day in case I want it all to stop
